$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/highlight.sty.title: $:/plugins/anttt/highlight/highlight.stylesheet
$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/highlight.sty.text:
<nowiki>#highlight-occurrencesCount {
color: black;
display: inline-block;
width: 6em;
padding-left: 0.5rem;
padding-right: 1.5rem;
}
#highlight-previous {
margin-left: 0.4rem;
}
#highlight-clear {
margin-left: 1rem;
}
#highlight-next,
#highlight-refresh {
margin-left: 0.2rem;
}
#highlight-next svg.tc-image-down-arrow,
#highlight-previous svg.tc-image-up-arrow,
#highlight-clear svg.tc-image-close-button,
#highlight-refresh svg.tc-image-refresh-button {
width: 1.2rem;
height: 1.2rem;
fill: #AAAAAA;
}
.highlight {
color:            {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-color}};
background-color: {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-background-color}};
}
.highlight-current {
color:            {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-current-color}};
background-color: {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-current-background-color}};
}
::highlight(highlight) {
color:            {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-color}};
background-color: {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-background-color}};
}
::highlight(highlight-current) {
color:            {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-current-color}};
background-color: {{$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/config/highlight-current-background-color}};
}
.doc-icon-block {
border-left: 2px solid #e1e1e8;
margin-left: 3em;
padding-left: 0.6em;
position: relative;
}
.doc-block-icon {
position: absolute;
left: -3em;
top: 0.2em;
}
.warning {
fill: maroon;
}
</nowiki>

$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/readme.title: $:/plugins/anttt/highlight/readme
$:/plugins/anttt/highlight/readme.text:
!!Find and highlight text This plugin provides an input field in the sidebar below the search input field and finds and highlights the text entered on the fly in the tiddlers in the story river. Up and down buttons provide for navigation between the occurrences. The input field and the highlighting (if any) are cleared when the story river changes, e.g., when new tiddlers are opened, open tiddlers are closed or reordered, tiddlers are edited, or when tabs are changed. The default highlight colors are @@.highlight all occurrences@@ and @@.highlight-current current occurrence@@. They can be changed on the Settings tab. The plugin has one subplugin: [[Highlight action-highlight|$:/plugins/anttt/highlight-action-highlight]], which allows the highlighting to be triggered by an action widget. See the //[[readme|$:/plugins/anttt/highlight-action-highlight]]// of the subplugin for details.
Warning
The plugin uses the [[CSS Custom Highlight API|https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/]], a recent World Wide Web Consortium specification @@color: red;not (yet) implemented by all browsers@@. [[Web features explorer|https://web-platform-dx.github.io/web-features-explorer/features/highlight/]] tracks the implementations. The plugin will not find and highlight text in browsers that have not yet implemented the specification. Instead, a message will be shown on input in the text field.
!!Limitations The plugin finds only text in ''text nodes''. It will not find text in input fields, input text areas and dropdown menus. The plugin will find text only on visible ''tabs''. Switching tabs will clear the search. Text in ''resizable parents'' not currently visible will be scrolled into view but only in the vertical direction. Text in ''Tiddlywiki's text editor'' will not be found. The reason is technical: TiddlyWiki"s text editor uses iframes and the content of iframes is inaccessible to the host page. ''CodeMirror's editor'', by contrast, does not use iframes and, consequently, does not have this limitation. Text in ''folded tiddlers'' is invisible and will also not be found. !!Uninstalling See Tiddlywiki's https://tiddlywiki.com/#Uninstalling%20a%20plugin page for instructions on how to uninstall the plugin. !!Acknowledgements Without TiddlyWiki's forum, https://talk.tiddlywiki.org, and its contributors development of this plugin would have taken much longer. Special thanks to the experts who generously took the time to answer my questions.

Invalid or empty color specifications will do no harm. """
